skill.name: Typography Foundations
skill.description: Set type for screen and print: measure, leading, tracking, optical sizes, weight axes, and the difference between display and text cuts.
skill.summary: Measure 45-75 chars (screen low, print wider). Leading coupled to measure and x-height: body 1.2-1.5, display 0.9-1.1. Tracking: lowercase display negative, caps positive +50 to +100; px does not scale, use em. Display vs text cut is optical compensation, crossover ~28-32pt. Weight reads heavier on screen; faux bold clogs counters. Justify works in print, breaks on web.
